How to play

  • Move basket with ← → or A D. Hold to glide.
  • Catch crystals:
  • Avoid bombs — they cost a life. 3 lives per run.
  • Difficulty rises every 250 pts. Faster fall, more bombs.
  • On mobile, drag the basket or use the ◀ ▶ buttons. Swipe anywhere.
